text:
maria: Proposal — automatic capacity-based fallback to a compatible quantized variant when the primary model is saturated. Limit rollout by customer tier (free/standard/startup). Thoughts on API surface + console/telemetry?
ajay: I'm +1 on safety guardrails, but worried about silent quality regressions. We should sample fallback outputs and run quick evals.
kevin: Also need per-tenant opt-out and a whitelist for enterprise customers. Console needs a clear "fallbacks active" indicator per-route.
lina: Implementation notes: router should annotate requests with headers `x-fallback-reason=capacity` and `x-variant-used=<name>`. Emit metric `fallback.count` with tags {tenant,route,variant,tier}.
deploy-bot: deploy: auto-fallback-router branch pushed to staging (build 487). Canary rolling out to 3 nodes.
ajay: config sketch (YAML):
```
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  allowed_tiers: ["free","standard","startup"]
  max_percent_per_minute: 30   # percent of that tenant's requests allowed to be diverted
  variants: ["gptj-quant-8bit","gptj-4bit"]
  sampling_eval: true
  sticky_seconds: 60
```
maria: Default behaviour I'd like: prefer_local_variant: true (same region), and sticky for 60s to avoid thrashing. Console should surface per-route fallback rate and sample diff view.
kevin: Edge case — what if fallback increases cost due to longer decode? Add cost-estimator and per-tenant cap. If estimated cost delta > threshold, prevent auto-fallback for that tenant.
lina: Console UX: route card shows badge "Fallbacks: 12/min"; click -> open recent sampled prompts + outputs with diff highlights. Also add a tracer span `fallback.router.decision` and a log line: `fallback decision: tenant=%s route=%s reason=capacity chosen=%s`
ajay: We must gate enabling with an eval pass against a small golden set per-tenant before flipping from `off` -> `auto`. Ops should be able to force `always` for testing.
maria: API header proposal: `X-Variant-Fallback: auto|off|always` (client override). Router default controlled by tenant policy. Any objections?
kevin: :thumbsup: No objections. Add a rollout flag in console to enable per-tenant.
lina: I'll wire up dashboards (Grafana) and a lightweight Kibana view for sampled diffs. Will create alerts for fallback_rate > 50% or sample-quality-drop > 5%.
maria: I'll draft RFC today with config API, header, telemetry names, and a small canary plan (staging -> 10% prod -> 50% -> full). Sync Thu 10am with SRE/devex/product.
kevin: ack.
ajay: I'll prep the eval harness and sample sets.
maria: thanks — assigning follow-ups in RFC.
